description: Na₆W₆Se₂O₂₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two WO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid, and edges with two WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-24°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.78 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.90 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with six WO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.86 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.78 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.58 Å. There are six inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with three WO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-50°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.29 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.43 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with three WO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-50°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.28 Å. In the fourth W site, W is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.41 Å. In the fifth W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four WO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-37°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.31 Å. In the sixth W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four WO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-37°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.09 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.78 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.70-1.83 Å. There are twenty-five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two W atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂W₂ tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two W, and one Se atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two W, and one Se atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one W, and one Se atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two W atoms. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one W atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Se tetrahedra. In the nineteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the twentieth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the twenty-first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the twenty-second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the twenty-third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Se atom to form distorted ONa₃Se tetrahedra that share corners with two ONa₂W₂ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Se tetrahedra. In the twenty-fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two W atoms. In the twenty-fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one W, and one Se atom.
